A number of members of the '''Mon Calamari''' species worked at two different [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel company ports over the years.

Two [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] served as supervisors at the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] facility at [[Spaceport THX1138]] around the time of an [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|incident]] there involving a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]]. They worked in the control booth overlooking the maintenance area where they directed various aspects of the facility's operations.<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

Mon Calamari also served in the same capacity from a similar control booth at Star Tours' [[Tomorrowland Starport]] years later, when a [[StarSpeeder 3000]] that left the port inadvertently arrived in the midst of a [[Battle of Death Star III|battle]]. Other Mon Calamari at Tomorrowland Starport included one working in a security booth overlooking the entrance to the facility. [[Unidentified Star Tours droid supervisor|Yet another]] was a droid supervisor.<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Star_Tours_Mon_Calamari_DLP_video.jpg|thumb|left|250px|One of the Mon Calamari at Spaceport THX1138]]
Two Mon Calamari figures could first be seen overlooking the queue of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride in all of its locations at [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] parks. Though they remained in the refurbished queue area of the updated ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', the rides' setting is considered to be a different spaceport. It's unclear if they should be considered to be the same two individuals.<ref name="ST" />

Another Mon Calamari figure could be seen in a security booth only found in the queue of the ''Star Tours'' ride at [[Disneyland]] in California. That booth and figure were removed before the original ride was replaced by ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' in [[2011]].<ref name="ST" />

A Mon Calamari droid supervisor portrayed by a puppet<ref name="EE Eklund">{{EndorExpress|url=star-wars-adventures/star-tours/creating-star-tours/2010/03/interview-with-lynette-eklund-ackbar-puppeteer|text=Interview with the Mon Calamari puppet builder}}</ref> appeared on a video screen in the queue of [[Tokyo Disneyland]]'s version of the ride.<ref name="ST" /> It was also removed before the attraction was updated in [[2013]].<ref name="ST2" />
